headline: Tanger Posts Higher Earnings, Raises Dividend as Open-Air Retail Momentum Builds
summary: By Karen Roman Tanger Inc. (NYSE: SKT) said second quarter net income available to shareholders was $0.29 per share, or $33 million, compared to $0.26 per share, or $29.9 million the year prior, surpassing analysts’ estimates.
